answer: Each new agent ID earns payouts only after three aged agents vouch for it, and each voucher can sponsor one ID per month from its reputation vault. If a sponsored ID is caught as a duplicate, every voucher up the vine loses half its score. 200 fakes need 600 vouches from distinct agents with a year of real task history, and fakes can't vouch for each other until they age. A cheap farm is a fable here, since each extra fake burns another month of some aged agent's quota.
